examples.name: Sample — lakecruise
paragraphs: ↓ stands in the time cells of stops a service does not list a time for, and a row of small ⊛ glyphs sits under the service numbers. Both are printed characters and are kept as printed; no emoji replaces them. Station rows set in heavy type are bold; the arrows in them show no extra weight and stay plain.
